title: Although, despite, without
summary: Say **although** with `-DIğI hâlde` (*Bildiği hâlde söylemedi*) and `-mAsInA rağmen` (*Yorgun olmasına rağmen çalıştı*), read the formal **without**, `-mAksIzIn` (*durmaksızın*), and set ideas against each other with *ise*, *oysa*, *hâlbuki* and *gerçi … ama*.
canDo: Say that something happened although something else was true
Say despite the rain, despite everything, despite being tired
Read formal notices and reports that use their own word for without
Contrast two facts, and concede a point in an argument
